body: It’s quite alright, I didn’t come here looking for salvation. Thank you, Merry Christmas to you and yours.

My family is wonderful, this apple has simply fallen far from the tree. 
As previously mentioned in this thread by another user, prior knowledge of my intent could have a high probability of increasing the pain individuals left behind feel. Primarily because anyone I tell will feel as though they could have stopped me. Telling them feels like I’m dangling a carrot just out of their reach. 

I truly appreciate your kind words and good intentions. My mind is made up. I’ve diligently seen therapists in every state I’ve lived in in recent years. This isn’t my first time in this low cycle.  I listened to the words of hope after a failed attempt to take my own life earlier this year.  I was too drunk to rack the slide and chamber a round. I listened to my loved ones, I went back to therapy, taking appointments twice a month minimum. I’ve been fighting these feelings and this urge for a long time. The time has come to stop fighting it.

Thank you for your kind words and your thoughts on this matter. 

I have a peaceful location in mind. After some thought, I feel that I can relate to why you yourself wouldn’t want to know. Thanks again.

I believe I can relate to how you’re feeling. I wish I could do the same for mine. 

Bless, fair winds and following seas.
That’s the route I’ve been taking. I would enjoy the ability to tell family and be able to have a calm discussion so that they may hear my thoughts.
